clues.text: This is the fifth largest city in El Salvador. It is a department capital in the south-east of the country.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside El Salvador, in the country's south-east

source.quote: is the fifth largest city in El Salvador, and capital of the Usulután Department in the south-east of El Salvador.

clues.text: Most of the year here is very hot and humid. The close Pacific Ocean helps keep the air damp and warm.
clues.narrowing: rules out cooler or drier inland places; points to a hot, humid low valley near the Pacific coast

source.quote: Usulután rests in a rich agricultural valley and has very high and humid temperatures most of the year as it is located close to the Pacific Ocean.

clues.text: Big quakes hit this city in February two thousand one. They hurt the town a lot and left deep marks.
clues.narrowing: shortlists to the Salvadoran city badly damaged by the February 2001 earthquakes

source.quote: The city was badly damaged by the Salvadorian earthquakes of February 2001, in addition to Hurricane Mitch in 1998.

clues.text: Hurricane Mitch hit this town too in nineteen ninety eight. It came a few years before the big quakes.
clues.narrowing: near-decisive: the city struck by both Hurricane Mitch in 1998 and the 2001 earthquakes

source.quote: The city was badly damaged by the Salvadorian earthquakes of February 2001, in addition to Hurricane Mitch in 1998.

clues.text: The main Catholic church stands in a park at the town center. It sits right next to the town hall and a cinema.
clues.narrowing: confirms the city whose central church, town hall, and cinema share one park area

source.quote: The main Catholic Church of the town is located in a park area next to the Town Hall (Alcaldia) and next to the Cine Centenario (a cinema) which are roughly located at the center of the town.
